subject: general
question: If (a)/(b) = 0.75, then the value of frac{{2a + b}}{{2a - b}} + (4)/(9) is:
solution:
**Given:**

a/b = 0.75

**Calculation:**

a/b = 0.75

⇒ a = 0.75b

Substitute a = 0.75b into the expression frac{{2a + b}}{{2a - b}} + (4)/(9)

⇒ (2(0.75b) + b)/(2(0.75b) - b)

⇒ &l
